mapper.sql: n.id, n.title, n.body, n.audience, n.status, n.published_at, n.created_by, u.name AS author_name, n.created_at, n.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_notices n LEFT JOIN tb_users u ON u.id = n.created_by WHERE n.id = #{id}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_notices n WHERE n.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND (n.published_at IS NULL OR n.published_at <= #{now})
AND n.audience = #{audience}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_notices SET title = #{title}, body = #{body}, audience = #{audience}, status = #{status}, published_at = #{publishedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, question, answer, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_faqs ORDER BY sort_order ASC, created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id, type, title, body, version, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_terms_contents WHERE type = #{type} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, code_group, code, name, sort_order FROM tb_common_codes WHERE code_group = #{codeGroup} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, code ASC
